punchline: Every great company starts with an important truth that most people don't yet believe.
thirty_sec: Peter Thiel's favorite interview question is: what important truth do very few people agree with you on? In Zero to One, he argues great businesses are built on secrets: truths that are hard to find but not impossible, between easy conventions and unknowable mysteries. Many people stopped looking. Yet Airbnb and Uber found secrets in plain sight: empty rooms and idle cars.
question: What important truth do very few people agree with you on?
